verdict: PASS — 7/7 candidates at 26/26 (185/185 rows). The matrix is saturated: it no longer discriminates between candidates; winner selection must come from the adversarial/review seats.
key_findings: All 105 fixture rows across all candidates emit the r4 vocabulary (VERIFIED / NOT-VERIFIED) with correct reason classes: observed negative reasons = vault-hash-mismatch (18), source-hash (4), vault-absent (7), source-absent (7), source-hash-mismatch (8), vault-sha-mismatch (3), source-sha-mismatch (2) — the alias spellings are the fixtures' declared equivalents (V2/V3 accept.note reason families).

Transient states observed and resolved by their authors mid-round: impl-20 mid-write syntax error (14:03); impl-21 initially shipped the r2 VERDICT/SAFE/NOT-SAFE contract with zero VERIFIED tokens (fixed in its 14:38 rewrite); impl-22/23 selftests failed while mid-write, pass after. Only the final bytes are scored.

impl-17's selftest is load-sensitive: its live-case leg reads tests/vault/case-V* while sibling seats rewrite them, so it can report 'FAIL live case-V1/note.md: got=NOT-VERIFIED(none)' or 'FAIL V19 rc=127' (2s CLI bound racing process startup) under load. Sequential runs: rc=0. Recorded as environmental; not a fixture failure.
case-V6's truncated-CRLF probe (V6c) was dropped by its author mid-round; an earlier impl-24 V6c miss is no longer part of the frozen fixture contract.

Judge semantics implemented from the fixtures' own declarations: class equality for bare must_not_be tokens (substring matching would veto the correct NOT-VERIFIED(...) answer — V3 must_not_be_note), substring for composite tokens, reason families per V2/V3 accept.note, must_not_be scoped off VERIFIED controls (V2 must_not_be_applies_to=the primary target). Rows are read with a 0x1f separator because bash `read` collapses empty TAB fields.

The official Obsidian CLI is FALLBACK-ONLY on this host (S08 census/round-4/cli-contract.json): no shim, no socket during the measurement window. All candidates correctly treat the ledger + sha256sum as the receipt of record; CLI is advisory at most.

safety.real_vault: read-only throughout (sha256sum/find only); fingerprint files=58 unchanged before/after every run
safety.gui_launcher: /usr/bin/obsidian never executed; a PATH tripwire named `obsidian` counts attempts through this runner (0 in every run). The raw app-process delta is recorded but a sibling seat's adversarial harness cycles the real app concurrently, so the tripwire is the invariant.
safety.fixture_writes: mktemp -d roots under /tmp and per-run ledgers only; no writes to tests/vault/case-V* (builders write their own roots), no writes to any sibling repo
safety.git: no fetch/push/commit/branch/checkout/reset/rebase anywhere; fixture builders run unmodified
